@@ -244,10 +244,24 @@ public class Jsoup {
      @param bodyHtml HTML to test
      @param whitelist whitelist to test against
      @return true if no tags or attributes were removed; false otherwise
-     @see #clean(String, org.jsoup.safety.Whitelist) 
+     @see #clean(String, org.jsoup.safety.Whitelist)
      */
     public static boolean isValid(String bodyHtml, Whitelist whitelist) {
-        return new Cleaner(whitelist).isValid(parseBodyFragment(bodyHtml, ""));
+        Document dirty = parseBodyFragment(bodyHtml, "");
+        Cleaner cleaner = new Cleaner(whitelist);
+        if (!cleaner.isValid(dirty)) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        // The HTML parser fixes malformed HTML (e.g., closes unclosed tags, removes stray tags).
+        // Check if the parser had to fix the HTML by comparing the original input to the parsed output.
+        String dirtyBodyHtml = dirty.body().html();
+        // Normalize both for comparison: convert quotes and remove excess whitespace
+        String normalizedInput = bodyHtml.replaceAll("'", "\"").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
+        String normalizedDirty = dirtyBodyHtml.replaceAll("'", "\"").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
+        if (!normalizedInput.equals(normalizedDirty)) {
+            return false;
+        }
+        return true;
     }
     
 }
